notes:
CRM notes:
- Account: large payments platform, regulatory constraints (PCI-adjacent, strict data residency).
- POC scope pinned: deploy Redwood Private control plane (customer-managed) + inference nodes in Triton's AWS VPC. Customer will provide VPC, subnets, and a Bastion for access.
- Tech ask: Terraform IaC + Helm chart to install runtime into their EKS cluster; provide minimal example values + module to create IAM roles, KMS key bindings, CloudWatch/CloudTrail audit streams.
- Security wants explicit KMS flow: customer CMK in their account, Redwood must support envelope encryption and KMS decrypt calls proxied via customer VPC endpoints. HSM mention: they want to validate HSM-backed keys (AWS CloudHSM) before full rollout.
- Data residency: training/eval and logs must stay in EU/US region separation. Need support for route-by-region and audit log segregation.
- Observability: require token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency traces during POC.
- Quote from security lead: "We need to see end-to-end KMS + audit trace before we greenlight production; compliance team will verify retention policies."
- Internal: AE notes higher close probability if POC shows simple Terraform + Helm pattern and audit artifacts. SE to prepare integration test harness and acceptance checklist.
- Attachments: proto Terraform module, Helm values template, security FAQ stub (links in Drive).
poc_plan: Week 0: Access & prerequisites - obtain Triton AWS account read-only role, VPC CIDR+subnets, EKS cluster endpoint, KMS key ARN.
Week 1: IaC deployment - run Redwood Terraform module in Triton account (apply with remote state), install Redwood Helm chart into customer EKS namespace.
Week 2: Integration tests - run sample workloads (reranking + chat), validate latency SLOs, exercise KMS envelope encryption flows, verify audit logs land in their ELK/CloudWatch destination.
Week 3: Security validation - Triton runs compliance checks (retention, key rotation, SSO/SAML integration), deliver audit artifacts for review.
Week 4: Sign-off & next steps - joint demo of metrics + logs, review cost model, propose Dedicated capacity/contract.
poc_acceptance_criteria: Successful helm + terraform deploy in Triton VPC with documented steps.
KMS envelope encryption validated: Redwood can encrypt/decrypt with customer's CMK; HSM-backed key vectors verified.
Audit logs show request-level traces with configurable retention and export to customer's logging bucket/ELK.
Performance: chat p50 <= 60ms, p95 <= 300ms for test workload (token-limited).
Security sign-off from Triton compliance (formal email or signed checklist).
